title: Refuse resume when the harness fingerprint changed
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Long-running work checkpoints outside chat. If the harness or graph configuration changes incompatibly, resume must refuse rather than continue with altered semantics. Accepts inspiration requirement 12[^insp-r12]. Contributes to personal-agent MH-PA-05 alongside `fangore_tdr_crash_after_accept_before_record`[^insp-pa-05-fingerprint].
implementation:
`GraphExecutor` fingerprint check on resume. `CliInstrumentor` verb `checkpoint_fingerprint_refuse`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
